mapper.sql: select o.order_id, o.order_no, o.user_id, o.elevator_id, o.fault_desc, o.fault_type, o.fault_level, o.order_status, o.reporter_phone, o.report_time, o.assign_time, o.accept_time, o.arrive_time, o.finish_time, o.confirm_time, o.assignee_id, o.assigner_id, o.reject_reason, o.deadline_time, o.del_flag, o.create_by, o.create_time, o.update_by, o.update_time, o.remark, u.nick_name as reporter_name, u.phonenumber as reporter_phone_no, e.elevator_code as elevator_code, e.brand as elevator_brand, e.unit_no as unit_no, b.community_id as community_id, b.building_no as building_no, c.community_name as community_name, w.nick_name as assignee_name, w.phonenumber as assignee_phone, ag.nick_name as assigner_name from repair_order o left join sys_user u on o.user_id = u.user_id left join sys_user w on o.assignee_id = w.user_id left join sys_user ag on o.assigner_id = ag.user_id left join elevator e on o.elevator_id = e.elevator_id left join building b on e.building_id = b.building_id left join community c on b.community_id = c.community_id
mapper.select: select count(1) from repair_order where del_flag = '0' and date_format(report_time, '%Y-%m') = date_format(sysdate(), '%Y-%m')
select count(1) from repair_order where del_flag = '0' and order_status not in ('confirmed') and deadline_time is not null and deadline_time < sysdate()

where o.del_flag = '0'
and o.order_status = 'pending' and o.report_time < date_sub(sysdate(), interval #{thresholdMinutes} minute)
and o.order_status = 'assigned' and o.assign_time < date_sub(sysdate(), interval #{thresholdMinutes} minute)
and o.order_status = 'accepted' and o.accept_time < date_sub(sysdate(), interval #{thresholdMinutes} minute)
and o.order_status in ('arrived','repairing') and o.arrive_time < date_sub(sysdate(), interval #{thresholdMinutes} minute)
and 1 = 0
order by o.report_time

select e.elevator_id as elevatorId, e.elevator_code as elevatorCode, c.community_name as communityName, b.building_no as buildingNo, count(o.order_id) as faultCount from elevator e left join building b on e.building_id = b.building_id left join community c on b.community_id = c.community_id left join repair_order o on o.elevator_id = e.elevator_id and o.del_flag = '0' and o.report_time >= #{beginTime} and o.report_time <= #{endTime} where e.del_flag = '0' and b.community_id = #{communityId} group by e.elevator_id, e.elevator_code, c.community_name, b.building_no order by faultCount desc, e.elevator_id

select b.building_id as buildingId, concat(c.community_name, ' ', b.building_no, ' ', b.unit_no) as buildingName, count(o.order_id) as faultCount from building b left join community c on b.community_id = c.community_id left join elevator e on e.building_id = b.building_id and e.del_flag = '0' left join repair_order o on o.elevator_id = e.elevator_id and o.del_flag = '0' and o.report_time >= #{beginTime} and o.report_time <= #{endTime} where b.del_flag = '0' and b.community_id = #{communityId} group by b.building_id, c.community_name, b.building_no, b.unit_no order by faultCount desc, b.building_id

select
date_format(o.report_time, '%Y-%m') date_format(o.report_time, '%x-%v') date_format(o.report_time, '%Y-%m-%d')
as timeLabel, count(o.order_id) as faultCount from repair_order o left join elevator e on o.elevator_id = e.elevator_id left join building b on e.building_id = b.building_id where o.del_flag = '0' and b.community_id = #{communityId} and o.report_time >= #{beginTime} and o.report_time <= #{endTime} group by timeLabel order by timeLabel

select o.fault_level as faultLevel, count(o.order_id) as faultCount from repair_order o left join elevator e on o.elevator_id = e.elevator_id left join building b on e.building_id = b.building_id where o.del_flag = '0' and b.community_id = #{communityId} and o.report_time >= #{beginTime} and o.report_time <= #{endTime} group by o.fault_level order by o.fault_level

select ifnull(o.fault_type, 'other') as faultType, count(o.order_id) as faultCount from repair_order o left join elevator e on o.elevator_id = e.elevator_id left join building b on e.building_id = b.building_id where o.del_flag = '0' and b.community_id = #{communityId} and o.report_time >= #{beginTime} and o.report_time <= #{endTime} group by faultType order by faultCount desc
